rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for physically going somewhere, leaving, attending a place, going to do an activity, and the colloquial toilet sense.

example.english: We’ll go to the toilet first.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 ci3 so2 sin1

rows.note: Use this when something changes into a new condition, form, colour, or state.

example.traditional: 飲完酒，我塊面變成紅色喇。
example.jyutping: jam2 jyun4 zau2 ngo5 faai3 min6 bin3 sing4 hung4 sik1 laa3

rows.note: Use this when “go” gives permission or an instruction to begin an action or process.

example.english: You can go ahead and start now.
example.jyutping: nei5 dei6 hoi1 ci2 zou6 laa1

rows.note: Use this construction to express an intention or plan to do something.

example.jyutping: ngo5 daa2 syun3 heoi3 leoi5 hang4
